page.overview:
What is Regulus Black I?

Regulus Black (1906 – 1959) was a pure-blood wizard and a member of the noble House of Black. He was the youngest child of Sirius Black (II) and Hesper Gamp and the younger brother of Arcturus Black (III) and Lycoris. Regulus never married and never had children.

Members of the House of Black and their history seem to have made a tradition of naming their children after stars and constellations. In Latin, Regulus means "little king" and was one term for a basilisk. As a name, it has also been applied to the star , which is situated at the heart of the lion in the constellation . Regulus was also the family name of a Roman general, Marcus Atilius Regulus, who was known for his honour and self-sacrifice.
